result: Hydrogen is the most abundant chemical element in the universe. It is a colorless, odorless, and tasteless gas that is highly flammable and explosive. It is the simplest element, consisting of a single proton and a single electron. Hydrogen is a key component of water and many organic compounds. It is also a major source of energy, as it can be used as a fuel for rockets and cars. Hydrogen is also a key component of the sun and other stars, where it undergoes nuclear fusion to produce energy.
